applies_to: all proton periods, pending run-by-run target verification

target.source: User-authorized 12 cm LH2 length from Ajaka PRL100 052003 (2008); nominal density 0.071 g/cm3 from pinned GEANT3 lagmat.F, not a measured density from Ajaka

target_calculation.formula: rho * length * N_A / M_H; counts proton nuclei, not H2 molecules

branching.source: eta->gamma gamma 0.3938, convention reported in Ajaka2008; pi0->gamma gamma 0.98823, PDG2024 https://pdg.lbl.gov/2024/listings/rpp2024-list-pi-zero.pdf; product used once only when both decays forced

flux_scale.source: User instruction: assume flux.root already absolute, tagging/monitor and live-time corrected; audit still pending

deferred: target length/density and uncertainty by acquisition period
